# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Only the latest build of the `master` branch is supported. Security fixes land on
`master` and ship in the next image; older builds do not receive backports.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report security vulnerabilities in TruffleHog to **security@posthog.com** or via PostHog's [security policy](https://github.com/PostHog/.github/blob/main/SECURITY.md). Do not open public GitHub issues for suspected security vulnerabilities.

For vulnerabilities affecting upstream Trino directly, please also see the [Trino security policy](https://trino.io/security.html) (`security@trino.io`).
